description: @floating-ui/dom 1.7.4 (M6 overlays, docs/design/M6-OVERLAYS.md) over the native layout, compared with the package in Chromium: computePosition with offset, flip, shift (with limitShift), arrow, size (apply writing the floating box's style) and hide, absolute and fixed strategies, a positioned container with a border and padding, a reference at the right edge flipped to the left, and autoUpdate (an overflow ancestor's scroll, the window's resize, ResizeObserver of the reference, IntersectionObserver of its position) re-positioning a floating box when its reference grows or its scroller scrolls
